observation_identity.counter_and_tlist: Every processed observation, including motion-rejected ones. tstamps_[graph_slot] stores observation counter, not the input timestamp.
observation_identity.graph_slots: Retained frame slot n; middle deletion renumbers these slots. Carry original observation index and sensor timestamp independently.
observation_identity.pose: Internal SE3 is world-to-camera, translation plus quaternion xyzw. Initialization gauge and monocular scale are arbitrary.
observation_identity.input: Official evaluate_tum.py:31-53 uses BGR undistort with original K, then crop x16/y8 to 608x464 and subtract principal-point offsets; DPVO stores that K/RES4. Image normalization is 2*(BGR/255)-0.5, not RGB or [-1,1].

candidate_and_admission.motion_prediction: For retained n>1, Pnew=Exp(0.5*((c-b)/(b-a))*Log(P_last*inverse(P_previous)))*P_last. P_last/P_previous are retained poses, but a,b,c are the last THREE ALL-OBSERVATION timestamps, including motion-rejected observations.
candidate_and_admission.first_two_retained_pose_seeds: Identity as allocated in PatchGraph; motion prediction is not itself a validated pose.
candidate_and_admission.inverse_depth_seed: Before initialization, one uniform [0,1) random inverse depth per new patch broadcast over its 3x3 cells. After initialization, use torch.median of all cells of last three retained frames: lower middle for even count, not NumPy median averaging. Record chosen RNG/seed; CPU RNG is not a bitwise reproduction of CUDA RNG. The source calls rand_like on EVERY candidate, even when initialized and immediately overwritten with the median; preserving a shared RNG stream requires consuming that draw too.
candidate_and_admission.motion_gate: If n>0 and not initialized, use last retained frame patches -> candidate frame; zero recurrent state; one learned Update; median via torch.quantile(delta.norm.float(),0.5). Strictly below 2 feature-grid pixels rejects, equality accepts. Gate uses delta, not delta+prior motion.
candidate_and_admission.rejection: counter/tlist advance, n/m do not. delta[current_observation]=(previous_observation,identity). Candidate feature/patch slot will be overwritten. This is not fresh tracking and probe net is not graph net.

edge_order_and_initialization.forward: After n increments: kk in [M*max(n-13,0),M*(n-1)); jj=n-1. Append first.
edge_order_and_initialization.backward: Then kk in [M*(n-1),M*n); jj in [max(n-13,0),n). ij meshgrid order: patch outer, target inner. Include self edges.
edge_order_and_initialization.state_carry: Append zero recurrent rows for new edges. Preserve old recurrent rows and edge order; update all current edges, do not truncate to a static E864 budget.
edge_order_and_initialization.before_initialized: Retained frames 1..7 append topology but run NO regular graph Update/BA.
edge_order_and_initialization.initialization: Exactly at retained n=8 set initialized before 12 Update calls. Each Update requests BA iterations=2: 24 BA steps. Do not call keyframe removal after this initialization loop.
edge_order_and_initialization.thereafter: One graph Update followed by keyframe selection/removal per admitted observation. Learned Update/correlation topology is dynamic, substantially different from fixed three-frame research probes.

update_and_ba.target: Reproject current geometry -> correlation -> recurrent learned Update; target is current 3x3 patch CENTER projection + delta.float(), weight.float(), lambda=1e-4.
update_and_ba.local_window: t0=max(n-OPTIMIZATION_WINDOW,1) when initialized, otherwise1; t1=n; iterations2; eff_impl=False. Frame0 remains fixed. In initialization initialized is already True.
update_and_ba.global_condition: Global BA condition checks any active ii<n-REMOVAL_WINDOW-1 and ran_global_ba[n], not LOOP_CLOSURE directly. With default loop-off lifetime/pruning, this should never arise. Minimal port should assert no such unexpected long edges rather than silently ignore them.
update_and_ba.inactive_edges: Only global BA concatenates inactive+active target/weight and normalizes depth/pose gauge. Normal local BA and learned Update use only active factors.
update_and_ba.official_failure_behavior: Official catches every BA exception, prints warning, then proceeds. A fail-closed CPU research port must disclose its stronger safety policy and record failure; no motion prediction or partial BA as validated fresh pose.
update_and_ba.precision_difference: Original code is CUDA; update() autocast(enabled=True) is unconditional even if cfg.MIXED_PRECISION=False. CPU FP32 research is a disclosed backend/precision adaptation, not an unmodified import of original DPVO.

keyframe_and_factor_lifecycle.removal_test: After ordinary update, i=n-5,j=n-3; if (motionmag(i,j)+motionmag(j,i))/2 <15 remove k=n-4. Not the newest frame.
keyframe_and_factor_lifecycle.flow_semantics: flow_mag beta0.5 blends full relative rotation+translation flow and translation-only flow. Translation-only means retain translation of Pj*inverse(Pi), set its quaternion identity. Projection clamps Z at0.1. motionmag averages every 3x3 pixel across selected edges and IGNOREs returned Z>0.2 valid mask. Threshold units are feature grid pixels.
keyframe_and_factor_lifecycle.removed_frame_relative_pose: Store observation-id keyed delta[t_deleted]=(t_previous,P_deleted*inverse(P_previous)). Delete factors with source or target k WITHOUT inactive storage; shift retained frames/caches/identities down; decrement kk byM where old ii>k, then ii/jj abovek by1. Filter/remap net rows identically.
keyframe_and_factor_lifecycle.source_age_pruning: After optional frame deletion, remove active factors whose source slot ix[kk]<n-22, STRICTLY <. Store their ii/jj/kk and frozen target/weight as inactive; do not keep or update recurrent net.
keyframe_and_factor_lifecycle.inactive_index_invariant: Official does not reindex inactive arrays during middle deletion. Under default temporal lifetime13/removal22 inactive endpoints precede k=n-4. Verify this invariant; do not change windows without revisiting it.
keyframe_and_factor_lifecycle.memory: Feature slots ring36 are not an observation-history bound. Pose/patch capacity4096 and inactive factors/delta/tlist have separate lifetime. Official guard rejects when n+1>=N. A smaller research capacity must fail explicitly and be recorded; never recycle historical slot identity.

termination_and_publication.terminate: With both loop capabilities disabled, no loop factors or classic callback. Still reset ran_global_ba[n] and run 12 additional graph Updates after source EOF.
termination_and_publication.reconstruction: Retained observation map -> current optimized world-to-camera poses. Other observations recursively reconstruct P(t)=dP(t)*P(parent). Skipped observations have identity dP; deleted frames use frozen relative dP. This is not fresh inferred observation and is not two-endpoint temporal interpolation. Finally inverse -> camera-to-world xyzw output paired with full input tlist.
termination_and_publication.online_policy: Emit fresh success only for the actual admitted current observation after initialization and successful finite current-frame learned Update+BA. Exactly bind original input id/timestamp after slot remap. Waiting, motion rejection, BA failure, EOF updates, historical reoptimization and reconstructed rows must remain separate statuses and counters; no carry-forward pose success.
termination_and_publication.startup_incomplete: EOF before eight admitted frames must be initialization_incomplete, not identity-derived tracking success. If choosing to skip unsupported finalization then disclose this policy difference.
minimal_safe_scope: single owner and ordered strictly increasing finite sensor timestamps
both LOOP_CLOSURE and CLASSIC_LOOP_CLOSURE false; no viewer/retrieval/normalization shortcut
original neural patch selection, Update, temporal graph topology and online fastBA equations
explicit capacity failure rather than arbitrary new history eviction
per-observation status and true fresh timing; final trajectory a separate artifact
same-current-reference gates and finite geometry do not establish independent VO trajectory accuracy or20Hz
